name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: Mocha goes with none of Almond, Pumpkin, or Vanilla.
Greta goes with at least one of Chai, Latte, or Caramel.
Either Vanilla goes with Felix or Hugo goes with Latte.
Dane, Greta, and Hugo go with Almond, Caramel, and Cinnamon, in some order.
Dane goes with exactly one of Cortado, Latte, or Almond.
Either Ava goes with Cinnamon or Cinnamon goes with Greta.
Caramel goes with Mocha if and only if Espresso does not go with Almond.
Between Caramel and Pumpkin, one goes with Cortado and the other with Mocha.
